# Ralph — Deep Context

## src/ralph-macchio.ts (1104 lines — autonomous agent loop)

### Module-Level State
- `mainWorkDir`, `workingDir`: mutable paths, start as PROJECT_DIR, updated by worktree creation
- `PLAN_PATH`, `PROGRESS_PATH`: mutable, derived from workingDir
- `activeChild`: currently running agent ChildProcess, signal handler target
- `stopping`: set true on SIGTERM
- `ITERATION_TIMEOUT_MS`: 30 minutes per iteration
- `SRT_BIN`, `SRT_AVAILABLE`: sandbox runtime detection at startup; `SRT_SETTINGS_PATH` is written per-run and cleaned up on exit

### main()
Flow: format/dedup/validate plan → setup worktrees → main iteration loop → final phases.
- Format: optionally runs `numberPlanTasks()` agent call (before worktree creation, so workingDir === PROJECT_DIR)
- Dedup: `dedupCheckboxes()` before worktree creation
- Validate: `validatePlanFormat(readPlan())` — exits with code 1 if invalid
- Worktree creation only happens AFTER format/dedup/validate
- `stopping` guard checked at top of each iteration

### extractCurrentTask()
Scans plan for first incomplete task. Priority: checkboxes before sections. Skips completed tasks (from progress.txt via readCompletedTasks). Section tasks include full body content until next header at same/higher level. Sections whose all child checkboxes are completed are skipped.

### areAllTasksDone()
Strict completion check: enumerates all task keys via `extractAllTaskKeys()` and verifies every key has a matching DONE entry in progress.txt. Returns false if no tasks found. Prevents false "done" on empty/corrupted plans.

### buildPrompt(taskDesc)
Embeds workingDir (scoped path constraint), plan/progress file names, RALPH_AGENT_CONTEXT (from wolfpack-context.ts), task description verbatim. Plan content is user/agent-authored — inherent prompt injection surface (not a code-level injection).

### runIteration(prompt)
Spawns agent. If `SRT_AVAILABLE`, wraps in srt sandbox: writes `.ralph-srt-settings.json`, builds inner command via `shellEscape()` joined with spaces, passes to `srt -c <cmd>`. Otherwise spawns agent directly.

Spawn: `nodeSpawn(bin, args, {cwd: workingDir, stdio: [ignore, pipe, pipe]})` — **no shell** (execve). 30-min timeout via setTimeout + killProcessTree. Output streamed to `.ralph.log` via appendFileSync per chunk. `activeChild` set synchronously before any await.

Note: spawn does NOT use `{detached: true}`. Child joins parent's process group.

### Plan corruption detection
After each iteration, compares task count before/after. If count shrinks:
1. Runs recovery iteration with snapshot as reference
2. If recovery also corrupts, restores from in-memory planSnapshot
3. Snapshot captured before each iteration — never itself corrupted
4. Recovery path calls `continue` — does not mark any task done that iteration

### Subtask expansion
Parses `<subtasks>` block from agent output. Appends as checkboxes to plan. Max 5 expansions (MAX_SUBTASK_EXPANSIONS). Budget ceiling: max(ITERATIONS*2, 100). When expansions exhausted, subtask content silently discarded. Parent task is force-marked done immediately after subtask emission. `lastWasSubtaskEmission` flag set so same-task-twice guard doesn't fire on the next iteration.

### Same-task-twice guard
Force-marks task done if picked on consecutive non-subtask iterations. Prevents infinite loops on persistently failing tasks. Guard resets after each subtask emission cycle.

### Task-mode sub-worktrees (WORKTREE_MODE === "task")
Each section task gets its own git worktree branch (`ralph/<N>-<slug>`). Checkbox subtasks within the section reuse the active worktree. On section boundary: `syncProgressBack()` → `mergeTaskBranch()` → `cleanupTaskWorktree()`. Merge failure is fatal (exits with code 1, preserves worktree for inspection). Orphan sub-worktrees from crashed runs are cleaned up at startup.

### SIGTERM handler
Synchronous: sets stopping, `killProcessTreeSync(activeChild.pid)` (~500ms), `cleanupAllExceptFinal(PROJECT_DIR)` (if WORKTREE_MODE !== "false"), `syncPlanToProject()`, appends log, `removeLock()`, `cleanupSrtSettings()`, `setTimeout(process.exit(0), 3500)`. Lock file also removed via `process.on("exit")` handler (double-remove is safe — ENOENT suppressed). `cleanupSrtSettings()` also called on exit handler.

### mergeTaskBranch(taskBranch)
`execFileSync("git", ["merge", "-m", `ralph: merge ${taskBranch}`, taskBranch])` — no `--` separator but taskBranch always starts with `ralph/` (non-flag). Aborts on conflict via `git merge --abort`.

### createMainWorktree()
Creates or resumes accumulator worktree. Branch: `ralph/plan-<planSlug>` (or `--worktree-branch` override). On restart: finds existing worktree via `listWorktrees`, resumes without overwriting plan/progress. Fresh start: deletes orphan branch from previous run, calls `createWorktree()`. Mutates mainWorkDir, workingDir, PLAN_PATH, PROGRESS_PATH, START_COMMIT.

### AGENTS record
Maps agent names to `{bin, args(prompt)}`. claude: `["--print", "--dangerously-skip-permissions", "--allowedTools", ALLOWED_TOOLS, "-p", prompt]`. codex/gemini/cursor have similar patterns. `resolveBin()` resolves each to absolute path at startup.

### appendSubtasksToPlan(subtasks)
Strips markdown headers, `~~`, AND embedded newlines (collapsed to space) from subtask text. Appends as `- [ ] <text>`. Newline collapsing was added to fix a prior issue where embedded newlines broke checkbox regex matching.

### syncFilesToWorktree() / syncProgressBack() / syncPlanToProject()
Three one-way sync helpers for gitignored plan/progress files across worktrees:
- `syncFilesToWorktree`: mainWorkDir → task sub-worktree (before each task iteration in task mode)
- `syncProgressBack`: task sub-worktree → mainWorkDir (after iteration, before merge)
- `syncPlanToProject`: mainWorkDir → PROJECT_DIR (so UI reads latest; no-op if same dir)

## src/ralph-skill-audit.ts

### buildAuditFixPrompt(params: AuditSkillParams)
Multi-phase prompt for security audit + fix phase (7 phases). Embeds diffBase (git SHA or HEAD~10), projectDir, planFile, progressFile. Runs inside `runIteration()` as `workingDir = mainWorkDir`. Values are text instructions for the agent — not executed by wolfpack. Reports written to progressFile.

## src/shared/process-cleanup.ts

### errMsg(e)
Universal error serializer. `instanceof Error` → `.message`, else `String(e)`. Never throws.

### isProcessAlive(pid)
Signal 0 probe. Returns false on ANY throw (including EPERM) — silent misreport if process exists but is cross-user (different UID). For ralph's use case (same-user spawned children), this is correct.

### killProcessTree(pid, timeoutMs=5000)
Async: SIGTERM to individual pid (NOT to process group — no group signal), poll every 200ms, SIGKILL after timeout, 200ms post-SIGKILL wait. Always resolves. No EPERM special-casing.

### killProcessTreeSync(pid)
Sync variant: SIGTERM to individual pid (NOT group), `spawnSync("sleep", ["0.5"])`, SIGKILL to individual pid. All exceptions silently discarded. ~500ms execution time.

## Cross-Module Coupling

`src/server/ralph.ts` (server-side coordinator) spawns ralph-macchio.ts as a detached subprocess via `nodeSpawn`. It:
- Writes the lock file before spawning (ralph-macchio removes it on exit/SIGTERM)
- Reads `.ralph.log` to stream progress to the UI
- Sends SIGTERM to the ralph PID to stop a running session

ralph-macchio.ts consumes:
- `wolfpack-context.ts`: RALPH_AGENT_CONTEXT, TASK_HEADER, countTasksInContent, validatePlanFormat
- `validation.ts`: expandBudget, resolveCleanupDiffBase, buildSrtSettings, shellEscape
- `worktree.ts`: createWorktree, cleanupAllExceptFinal, removeWorktree, listWorktrees, slugifyTaskName
- `shared/process-cleanup.ts`: errMsg, killProcessTree, killProcessTreeSync

---

## Invariants

1. Lock file exists for the full lifetime of ralph-macchio.ts; removed on any exit path (SIGTERM, normal, fatal error, process.on("exit"))
2. `activeChild` is set synchronously before any await in runIteration; cleared in both "close" and "error" handlers
3. Plan task count must not decrease across an iteration; violation triggers recovery before marking any task done
4. `PLAN_PATH`/`PROGRESS_PATH` always point to mainWorkDir (never task sub-worktree) — the single source of truth
5. Format/dedup/validate run in PROJECT_DIR before worktree creation; workingDir === PROJECT_DIR at that point
6. srt settings file written immediately before spawn, cleaned up on exit and SIGTERM
7. Merge failures are fatal and exit code 1; task sub-worktree is preserved for manual recovery

## Known Issues / Smells

- **process-cleanup.ts:12** — `_warn` hardcodes `component: "pty"` in a module that has nothing to do with PTY; misleading in log output
- **process-cleanup.ts:22-29** — `isProcessAlive` returns false on EPERM (cross-user process), but this is undocumented and callers in ralph assume single-user; would silently declare a living cross-user process dead
- **ralph-macchio.ts:661** — `mergeTaskBranch` lacks `--` separator between options and taskBranch (safe only because branch always starts with `ralph/`, but fragile contract)
- **ralph-macchio.ts:970** — when MAX_SUBTASK_EXPANSIONS is exhausted, subtask content is silently discarded with no log entry — debugging subtask budget exhaustion is difficult
- **ralph-macchio.ts:574** — `logSummary` re-reads LOG_FILE from disk to parse start time; fragile (assumes log format stability) and wastes an I/O round trip
- **ralph-macchio.ts:125** — `SRT_AVAILABLE` detection: `resolveBin` returns the bare name if `which` fails, so the check `SRT_BIN !== "srt"` is correct but brittle — any agent named exactly "srt" would falsely report unavailable
- **ralph-macchio.ts:851** (early-exit no-task path) — calls `runFinalPhases()` only if `i > 1`; if the plan is already complete on the very first iteration check, final phases are skipped entirely

## Key Flows

### Spawn
`main()` → optional `numberPlanTasks()` → `dedupCheckboxes()` → `validatePlanFormat()` → `createMainWorktree()` (if worktree mode) → orphan sub-worktree cleanup → iteration loop

### Loop Iteration
`extractCurrentTask()` → same-task-twice check → task-mode worktree setup → snapshot plan → `buildPrompt()` → `runIteration()` → corruption check → subtask parse → `markTaskCompleted()` → `syncPlanToProject()`

### Cleanup / SIGTERM
`stopping = true` → `killProcessTreeSync(activeChild.pid)` → `cleanupAllExceptFinal()` → `syncPlanToProject()` → `removeLock()` → `cleanupSrtSettings()` → `setTimeout(process.exit(0), 3500)`

### Final Phases (all tasks done or iterations exhausted)
`runFinalPhases()` → optional `runAuditFix()` (workingDir = mainWorkDir) → optional `runCleanup()` (workingDir = mainWorkDir) → `syncPlanToProject()` → `logSummary()` → `removeLock()`
